newsitem.title: POLAND: Budimex down 3rd time on profit view cut.
newsitem.headline: Budimex down 3rd time on profit view cut.

text.p: Polish builder Budimex SA on Tuesday fell at or close to the daily maximum 10 percent for the third session running to 19.8 zlotys, on last Thursday's news it had revised down its 1997 pre-tax profit forecasts, traders said.

On Thursday Budimex said it had revised down its 1997 group pre-tax profit forecast to 23 million zlotys from the 33.7 million given at the start of year and parent pre-tax to 15 million zlotys from 25.7 million.
Budimex said the revision was in part due to a downturn of the business cycle on the German and Czech markets and limited sales in the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS).
The firm said it did not expect any significant improvement on those markets in the second half and would seek to minimize effects of the slow-down.

Tuesday supply for Budimex after fixing was strong enough for players to have their offers reduced, unlike the previous two sessions when the stock did not trade due to excess supply. Traders said the stock's fall should now slow.
